To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

“The more a public administration can be opened up to public participation, the more relevant and consistent its policies and the better it will cooperate with other administrations and stakeholders.”
the implementation of policy is a complex, multi-layered, multi-level, multi-actor, and dynamic process.

1) the strategic management of the public sector is a dynamic process that is not only about planning, implementation, and evaluation, but also about the continuous exploration of new opportunities and threats; and 2) the strategic management process can be improved by using foresight as an instrument to enhance the relevance, consistency, coherence, and cooperation of policies and administrative structures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: what is the best way for public administrations to implement policy and reform?
strategic public management as a way to improve policy relevance, cooperation and coordination.
how to open up public strategic management to improve policy and administration.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the public sector is a complex, dynamic and uncertain environment, and the strategic management of public organizations must be able to adapt to these circumstances.
the public sector should not be a ‘closed’ system but should open up to the environment.
strategic management can be improved by the use of foresight methods and tools.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it is an attempt to open up public strategic management by means of foresight, a process which is based on the idea of creating a space for dialogue, participation and reflection on the future.
we have been exploring and experimenting with a variety of methods and approaches for the purpose of improving policy and management relevance, coherence, and cooperation.
the strategic management of public administration is about the management of change.
The main takeaway from our work is that
strategic public management is not just about planning and implementing, but also about exploring, and that the latter can be made more systematic and effective by the use of foresight methods.
the strategic management of public organizations is not just about planning, but also about creating a space for the exploration of alternative paths to the future.
strategic public management is about opening up the policy process and making it more participatory, transparent, coherent and cooperative.
